dct_description_sm: 1) Improve our knowledge of the ecology of berry producing species and monitor berry productivity (g/m) in relation to environmental change; 2) Document natural variability in distribution and abundance of berry producing species; 3) Establish long-term berry monitoring; 4) Establish small warming experiments (open-top chamber, OTC) following International Tundra Experiment protocols (www.geog.ubc.ca/itex/) to evaluate their impact on vegetation.
dct_title_s: Berry productivity and environmental monitoring in the context of climate change at Daring Lake
